headline: AKI India Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: AKI India Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or change in control event requiring public disclosure.
detail: AKI India Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is triggered when an acquirer crosses 25%, 50% or 90% shareholding thresholds or enters into agreements to acquire control. The specific acquirer identity, value, and timeline details are contained in the filed disclosure document.
